company.name: Mobiserve
company.shortDescription: mobile car maintenance services, care care and emergency services. all in one app
company.description:
MobiServe(formally known as AFS) is a convenient high quality car service provider that maintains customers’ car wherever they are. It is one of the only businesses that only focusses on mobile car services; helping its B2B as fleet maintenance management  or B2C customer to skip the hassles of a traditional shop. That means our customers save time, save costs, and skip the enormous headache of moving vehicles to and from a shop during business hours. MobiServe has the know-how of car maintenance service using the latest technologies and equipment with a team of specialized experts in the field of service centers and diagnostic services.
mobiserve will introduce a must have app for any car owner; that will include emergency services, car care and emergency towing services.
